title: Hold a pipeline licence
what: Construct or operate a pipeline (other than a distribution or produced water pipeline) only under a pipeline licence, petroleum tenure or other listed authority.

laws.title: Petroleum and Gas (Production and Safety) Act 2004 (Qld)

sources.title: Petroleum and Gas (Production and Safety) Act 2004 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not construct or operate a pipeline, other than a distribution pipeline or a produced water pipeline, unless— (a) the construction or operation is— (i) carried out— (A) under this Act and under the authority of a petroleum tenure, a pipeline licence or a petroleum facility licence;
